gloss: to exchange conversation; to have a conversation

definitions.gloss: to exchange conversation; to have a conversation; to converse
definitions.explanation: To engage in back-and-forth conversation with someone. Slightly more formal or literary than simply {話|はな}す, emphasizing the mutual, reciprocal nature of the exchange.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I had a conversation with the person next to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I enjoyed a pleasant conversation with my friend after a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わせる→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become able to naturally converse even with people I'm meeting for the first time.

notes:
A set expression combining ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧ ('conversation') with the verb ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ ('to exchange'). The verb ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ adds a nuance of mutual, reciprocal exchange not present in simple ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧.

USAGE:
- More literary and descriptive than casual ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ or ⟦しゃべる→しゃべる：02117_shaberu⟧
- Often used in narrative and written contexts to describe social interactions
- The same verb ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ appears in similar reciprocal expressions: ⟦{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす→言葉を交わす：19502_kotobawokawasu⟧ ('to exchange words'), ⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ ('to exchange greetings')

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to have a brief conversation
- ⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to have an enjoyable conversation
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to converse in English
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{会話|かいわ}を{交|か}わす: to communicate through eye contact

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす→言葉を交わす：19502_kotobawokawasu⟧: to exchange words — more general, can be brief
- ⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧: to exchange greetings — specifically about greetings
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a talk — more casual and everyday
